convention_statement: s_str is indexed by LOGICAL QUBIT: s_str[i] = planted bit on logical system qubit i (i=0..n-1, left to right, 0-indexed). s_bits_msb_last = s_str[::-1] = qiskit measurement-register order (register position 0 = highest-index bit). BUILDER embeds s_str[i] on logical qubit i; DECODER reports s_hat in s_str (logical-qubit, 0-indexed) order; HD vs s_str directly. Position labels in reveals are 0-indexed. Commitment = sha256((s_str+salt).encode()).
